verdict.rationale: Pulumi CrossGuard/Policy-as-Code lets teams define guardrails in code enforced across Pulumi, Terraform, CloudFormation, or manual resources, and blog evidence shows policy violations surfaced as PR comments/checks that gate changes; combined with `pulumi preview` for pre-apply validation, this directly supports blocking non-compliant changes before apply. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of enforcement blocking (vs. warn-only) and detail on mandatory vs advisory policy packs in CI.
